mechanism: Ginkgo biloba inhibits platelet aggregation and contains ginkgolides that may potentiate anticoagulant effects, while piroxicam inhibits platelet function and increases GI bleeding risk through COX inhibition.
action: Monitor for signs of bleeding (petechiae, ecchymosis, GI symptoms); consider alternative NSAID or discontinue ginkgo; educate patient on bleeding precautions.
